'''17,012 BBY''' was a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]] that was part of the [[Indecta Era]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During this year, forces from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] [[Alsakani liberation of Virujansi|liberated]] the planet [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as part of the [[First Alsakan Conflict]], which lasted from [[17,018 BBY]] to [[16,700 BBY]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
17,012 BBY was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGTW" />
